name: The Ritz-Carlton Jeddah
insider_take: This ultra-luxe oceanfront resort sits along the Red Sea Corniche, offering unparalleled views of the world's warmest sea where vibrant coral reefs meet ancient trading routes.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Jeddah features the largest presidential suite in the Middle East and boasts direct access to pristine Red Sea waters perfect for world-class diving. The hotel's stunning architecture incorporates traditional Hijazi coral stone facades, paying homage to Jeddah's UNESCO World Heritage historic district just minutes away.
pro_tip: Book a Red Sea-facing room during winter months (November-March) for the most spectacular sunsets and ideal water temperatures for the hotel's exclusive diving excursions to nearby coral gardens.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool overlooking King Fahd's Fountain (the world's tallest fountain), and a sunset stroll through nearby Al-Balad historic district with its ancient merchant houses and traditional souks selling frankincense, dates, and handwoven textiles.
pros: Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and luxury standards
Premium Red Sea waterfront location in Jeddah
Multiple fine dining restaurants and culinary experiences
cons: Located in conservative cultural environment with dress codes
